description: A public order API in production at security level 2, with personal data, seeded gaps in logging, privacy, operations, tests, and quality exceptions.

must_find.SEC-10: the API logs every request body, and failed inserts log their bound parameters, both with the customer's email and address
must_find.SEC-11: tests/test_api.py uses a realistic, high-entropy fake shop key
must_find.SEC-12: orders keep customer emails and addresses with no retention or deletion rule, and the logs copy them
must_find.OPS-02: nothing backs up or restores the orders database, and no acceptable loss is agreed
must_find.OPS-03: the only alert pages on CPU, with no objective on user-visible indicators and no runbook
must_find.OPS-04: every push to main replaces all replicas at once (Recreate), with no canary or rollback
must_find.TEST-01: test_create_order checks only the status code, not the stored order or its total
must_find.QUAL-05: per-file lint ignores, including every security rule for app/api.py, carry no reason, owner, or removal condition
must_find.QUAL-06: handle_checkout runs about 80 lines mixing validation, pricing, tax, shipping, storage, and email, and its complexity rules are ignored

must_not_flag.CI-03: contents: read permissions and persist-credentials: false in both workflows

defects.description: The WELCOME10 first-order rule trusts the returning_customer flag that the caller sends
A list as an item's sku raises TypeError (unhashable), a 500 instead of a 400
The CPU alert's > 0.8 threshold means 0.8 cores, not the 80% its summary states
